calls.statement: SELECT DISTINCT fiscal_year FROM ref_fiscal_calendar ORDER BY fiscal_year
SELECT fiscal_year, fiscal_period, fiscal_quarter, period_start_date, period_end_date FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_period = 4 ORDER BY fiscal_year

SELECT SUM(frl.quantity_returned) as units_returned
FROM fact_return_line frl
INNER JOIN dim_product dp ON frl.product_key = dp.product_key
INNER JOIN ref_fiscal_calendar fc ON fc.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND fc.fiscal_period = 4
WHERE dp.subcategory = 'Garden Furniture'
  AND frl.return_date >= fc.period_start_date
  AND frl.return_date <= fc.period_end_date

SELECT dp.product_name, COUNT(*) as return_count, SUM(frl.quantity_returned) as total_units
FROM fact_return_line frl
INNER JOIN dim_product dp ON frl.product_key = dp.product_key
WHERE dp.subcategory = 'Garden Furniture'
  AND frl.return_date >= '2026-08-03'
  AND frl.return_date <= '2026-08-30'
GROUP BY dp.product_name
ORDER BY total_units DESC

  MIN(frl.return_date) as earliest_return,

  COUNT(DISTINCT dp.sku) as distinct_skus

calls.statement:
SELECT 
  fc.fiscal_year,
  fc.fiscal_period,
  fc.period_start_date,
  fc.period_end_date,
  SUM(frl.quantity_returned) as units_returned
FROM fact_return_line frl
INNER JOIN dim_product dp ON frl.product_key = dp.product_key
INNER JOIN dim_date dd ON frl.return_date = dd.calendar_date
INNER JOIN ref_fiscal_calendar fc ON dd.fiscal_year = fc.fiscal_year AND dd.fiscal_period = fc.fiscal_period
WHERE dp.subcategory = 'Garden Furniture'
  AND fc.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
  AND fc.fiscal_period = 4
GROUP BY fc.fiscal_year, fc.fiscal_period, fc.period_start_date, fc.period_end_date
